title: Full Stack Midlevel Software Engineer

description:
Description
SLC works on behalf of clients to support utility-scale thermal, solar, wind, battery energy storage, and other power generating and infrastructure projects. We evaluate and optimize technical, commercial, environmental, and financial aspects of the projects for a variety of clients.
This position will require you to perform civil engineering reviews and prepare preliminary civil designs, and to understand power projects and distill technical expertise into actionable information that project stakeholders rely on to prudently develop, design, construct, operate, and finance those projects. Working in multi-disciplinary project teams, you will perform tasks such as the following:

• Perform civil engineering reviews, including storm water drainage, sanitary sewer systems, road design, and earthwork

• Support preparation of general arrangement drawings in coordination with other disciplines, such as mechanical and electrical engineers

• Prepare preliminary civil designs including items such as grading, erosion control, drainage and stormwater, wastewater, and access roads designs, with the associated bill of quantities

• Prepare and review technical specifications to define construction requirements

• Advise power project developers

• Evaluate new power and infrastructure projects independently to support financing

• Develop technical reports for applicable audiences - including owners, developers, governmental agencies and committees, and financiers

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.
Qualifications
We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.
Essential skills and experience:

• This position requires a Bachelor's degree in civil engineering. A Master’s degree in civil/structural engineering or business (e.g., MBA) discipline is a plus.

• 10+ years of experience in design techniques, tools, and principles involved in the production of technical plans, drawings, calculations, and models.

• 5+ years of experience in detailed design of site grading and drainage, stormwater systems, road design, transport plans, track design, and ponds.

• Proficiency with civil engineering software programs such as ArcGIS Pro, Autodesk Civil 3D, HydroCAD, StormCAD, PondPack, FLO-2D Pro, and AutoTURN. Must be capable of working in geospatially located tools.

• Power plant (combined cycle, simple cycle, nuclear, wind, solar) project design experience.

• Experience in writing and providing support documentation for Civil Engineering specifications or calculations.

• Ability to work in a team environment.

• Ability to prioritize multiple parallel, fast-paced tasks within schedule and assigned budget.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including technical evaluation report writing.

Valued but not required skills and experience:

• Professional Engineering (PE) license

• Data analysis and visualization

• Project finance or business acumen

• Construction project management and/or scheduling software knowledge

• Project planning, leadership, and organizational skills

AI & Automation at Sargent & Lundy

title: Link-Building Outreach Specialist (£27K - £33K DOE)
description:
We're the team iGaming operators turn to when growth matters most - and we're growing fast ourselves. At Receptional , you'll find colleagues who are bright, ambitious, and genuinely supportive. Specialists who do their best work together, sharing ideas, moving fast, and holding themselves to a high bar.

Whether you're starting out or stepping up, you'll get genuine investment in your development through our internal academy, real variety in your work, and a direct impact on some of the biggest names in the industry. Competitive benefits, flexible working, and a team that has your back.

We were named Marketing Services Supplier of the Year at the EGR B2B Awards 2026, and Best Medium Agency to Work For at the Company Culture Awards 2025 - recognition for the work we do and the place we've built to do it.

Link-building in iGaming is one of the most challenging outreach environments in digital marketing. The sector is heavily scrutinised, publisher standards are high, and the placements that actually move the needle take real skill to secure. As a Link-Building Outreach Specialist at Receptional you'll be working across a portfolio of iGaming clients with genuine account ownership, real variety, and a team that takes outreach seriously as a discipline - not an afterthought. If you want to work somewhere that invests in doing this properly, this is worth a look. What We're Looking For

You'll need to be analytically sharp, commercially aware, and genuinely comfortable in client-facing situations. This isn't a role where you can hide behind spreadsheets - you'll be pitching publishers, negotiating placements, and presenting performance to clients who expect results. At the same time, you need to be a strong day-to-day operator: organised, proactive, and on top of the detail across multiple accounts simultaneously.

Essential:

• At least 1 year's experience in off-page SEO and link-building, ideally agency-side

• A proven ability to craft compelling, persuasive outreach communication that gets results

• Proficient with outreach and SEO tools - BuzzStream, Ahrefs, or equivalent

• Data-driven mindset: you set measurable goals, track performance, and optimise based on what the numbers tell you

• Strong organisational skills - you manage multiple client deadlines simultaneously without things slipping

• Comfortable presenting to clients and internal stakeholders

• Comfortable using AI tools to support content production and outreach workflows

Desirable:

• Experience in digital PR campaigns

• Some knowledge of SEO or content optimisation

• iGaming or regulated-sector experience - we'll get you up to speed if not

How you'll be measured

Link diversity targets met each month, content quality and output against agreed timelines, deadline adherence across all client deliverables, and outreach effectiveness - open rates, placement success rate, and live links secured. What You'll Be Doing

This is a hands-on outreach role where you'll be running strategic link-building campaigns for iGaming clients from end to end. That means researching targets, crafting pitches, negotiating placements, and producing content that meets publisher editorial standards - all at pace, across multiple accounts simultaneously. There's no hiding behind process here; you'll be expected to own your accounts, drive results, and bring strategic thinking to everything you do.

In practice, that looks like:

• Researching and developing strategic link-building plans that maximise ROI across your client portfolio

• Sourcing relevant publications and websites aligned to each client's sector and objectives

• Crafting compelling outreach communications and negotiating placements within agreed parameters

• Developing targeted content assets designed to secure placements - written to editorial standard, built around what publishers actually want

• Monitoring and analysing campaign performance continuously - optimising what isn't working, doubling down on what

tags: Manufacturing : Imaging Production : Imaging - Supply Chain
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Senior Supply Chain Manager to play a critical role in managing and optimizing procurement, supply planning, subcontracts, material flow, inventory, and warehousing operations across our Lexington and Waltham locations. This role will be instrumental in executing supply chain strategies to support Anduril’s rapid growth. Your expertise will contribute significantly to the efficient and resilient supply chain for critical imaging products and programs in the defense sector. You will manage cross-functional projects to achieve cost, quality, and delivery targets.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Drive Supply Chain Planning & Optimization: Execute supply chain strategies, optimizing material flow, inventory management, and operational efficiency through continuous process improvement and KPI monitoring to support our rapid scaling.

• Lead Strategic Procurement & Supplier Management: Manage critical supplier relationships, drive performance, and lead negotiations for commercial terms to ensure supply continuity, cost effectiveness, and adherence to quality and delivery standards.

• Execute Technical Sourcing & Supplier Qualification: Support make/buy analyses and manage source selection processes, technically qualifying suppliers to meet stringent design, quality, and schedule requirements for complex components and systems.

• Proactive Risk Management: Identify, assess, and develop mitigation strategies for potential supply chain risks and disruptions, ensuring resilience and continuity of supply.

• Manage & Develop Supply Chain Talent: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of supply chain professionals, fostering a high-performance environment and ensuring the effective execution of team objectives.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field

• 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience, with at least 3 years in a management or team lead role, preferably in aerospace & defense, propulsion, or regulated manufacturing.

• Strong background in procurement, subcontracts, material planning, and warehouse/inventory operations.

• Knowledge of FAR/DFARS, ITAR, and defense contracting practices.

• Proven ability to lead or participate in complex negotiations and deliver results on cost, schedule, and quality.

• Experience in optimizing supply chain processes during high growth or production ramps.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

title: Product Manager (Interviews & Interview Assessment)
description:
Product Manager (Interviews & Interview Assessment)

CAS Shield & Apply

📍 Location: Remote (with purpose-driven in-person meetups in London)

📝 Contract: Full-time, permanent

📅 Start Date: Immediate

💼 Reporting to: Deputy Director of CAS Shield, with a dotted line to the Deputy Director of Apply

🛂 Note: Candidates must be UK-based, have the right to work in the UK, and be able to travel to London for team meet-ups

About Enroly

At Enroly, we’re transforming the way universities recruit, assess and onboard international students. Our platforms are used by a significant share of UK higher education institutions to streamline compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve the international student experience.

This role sits across our two core products:

• CAS Shield - our flagship compliance and pre-CAS platform, trusted by nearly half of UK higher education institutions to manage visa readiness, credibility and onboarding at scale.

• Apply - our application and admissions product, where institutions, agents and applicants come together at the very start of the student journey.

Enroly was recently acquired by Ecctis, the UK’s leading authority on international qualifications and skills benchmarking. Ecctis delivers essential services including qualification evaluation, recognition frameworks, and global consulting to governments, education providers, and employers. Together, we’re building a future-proofed approach to student recruitment and enrolment, backed by unparalleled data, insight, and capability.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Interviews and Interview Assessment across CAS Shield and Apply.

This is not a backlog-management role. You will be expected to define the product direction, make strategic trade-offs and establish how interviewing and assessment should work across Enroly's products.

Interviewing is one of the highest-stakes moments in the international student journey. Institutions use it to establish credibility, assess English language ability, and make admissions and compliance decisions that carry real regulatory weight. Applicants experience it on a mobile phone, often on a poor connection, in a different time zone, and frequently as their first direct interaction with the university.

Your job is to make that experience work - fair, credible, defensible and genuinely usable at scale. You’ll own the roadmap for asynchronous and live interviewing, assessment and scoring, and the integrity and proctoring capabilities that sit around them. This is a build-and-scale role: parts of this space are new, and you’ll be shaping direction as much as delivering against it.

This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can balance applicant experience against institutional and regulatory needs, and is excited to define a product area rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Do

• Own and drive the product roadmap for Interviews and Interview Assessment across both CAS Shield and Apply, aligned with Enroly’s company strategy.

• Define the interviewing model: asynchronous and live formats, question design and banks, scoring rubrics, reviewer workflows, and assessment outputs institutions can act on and defend.

• Own integrity and proctoring: identity verification, fraud and impersonation signals, AI-assisted detection, and the balance between assurance and a humane applicant experience.

• Lead the mobile-first applicant experience - video capture, low-bandwidth resilience, accessibility, and drop-off reduction across devices and geographies.

• Make the case for AI where it genuinely helps - transcription, summarisation, scoring support, anomaly detection - while keeping humans accountable for decisions.

• Ensure interviews and assessment work coherently across two products, with a consistent experience for applicants and clear ownership boundaries internally.

• Work directly with university admissions and compliance teams, agents, applicants

Capita delivers complex transformation programmes at scale to the Ministry of Defence and Front-Line Commands and is continuing its journey to become Defence's trusted transformation partner, enhancing operational readiness, workforce capability, efficiency and modernisation through AI-enabled, technology-driven services and a world-class partner ecosystem.

We’re growing our Defence Market Development team and we’re looking for an experienced business development professional to join the team as a Market Development Director (MDD), to deliver strategic growth across our defence business and adjacent client groups (e.g. national security agencies). If you're driven by innovation, thrive in dynamic environments, are driven by solving our customers’ biggest challenges and excel at spotting market opportunities, this is your chance to make a lasting impact. Job title:
Market Development Director (Defence) Job Description:
This role is home-based but will require travel as necessary to support our business.
What you’ll be doing
As one of our MDDs you’ll be primarily responsible for creating market demand and originating warm opportunities before formal procurement, working closely with our business development and capture teams. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Developing new market opportunities in the defence sector to unlock fresh revenue streams

• Generating a healthy funnel of prospects and opportunities to meet long-term pipeline targets

• Creating and delivering account-based growth strategies for assigned prospects and customers

• Developing executive relationships across Defence including the and defence industry and other key stakeholders

• Championing our defence strategy, engaging technology, proposition and capture teams early in the sales cycle, to shape major procurements towards our strengths and capabilities

• Leading new prospect engagement and early qualification by aligning Capita expertise with client needs

• Raising the profile of our brand, intellectual property and services through strategic partnerships, client engagement and thought leadership

• Represent the company at defence events, industry forums and customer engagements.

• Providing insight on emerging trends and customer priorities, to shape proposition development and go-to-market strategies

• Creating and sharing cross-sell and up-sell opportunities to maximise value across the client group.

What we’re looking for
Essential

• Substantial experience successfully selling into the UK Defence market, particularly complex BPO and technology solutions

• Established relationships and strong customer network across MOD (notably Cyber & Specialist Operations Command and the NAD Group) and the defence industry.

• Extensive knowledge of Government business development, MOD procurement, contract awards, current procurement trends and customer buying behaviours.

• Proven track record of driving year-on-year business growth, meeting or exceeding targets and leading new business campaigns. Opportunity values can range from £30M to £500M+

• Experience shaping opportunities and creating compelling, winning propositions with partners, vendors and consortium members.

• Strong interpersonal, influencing, presentation and verbal communication skills

• SC clearance as a minimum (or the eligibility to acquire it on joining).

Desirable

• Experience selling into wider Government (security and intelligence) and national security organisations
About Capita Growth
Our Growth Function is one of Capita ’s central functions and is redesigning how we do business. We’re improving and standardising our sales processes, and creating consistency in training, technology and knowledge sharing. We’re also multi-lingual, multi-functional and multi-talented. Join us and discover better as you empower our sales teams to focus on developing our business.
What’s in it for you?

• A competitive basic salary between £105,000 - £120,000 plus bonus and benefits

title: Director of Demand Generation
description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.
We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.
We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!

The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Director of Demand Generation to own a qualified pipeline from first touch to sales handoff. You’ll drive leads across three channels: paid advertising (Google, LinkedIn), organic search and SEO, and AI-powered search and LLM visibility (GEO). You’ll report to the VP of Marketing, and partner closely with our Sales team.
This is a builder role. You’ll own the strategy, run the channels, and build the agentic workflows that make the whole machine run more efficiently over time. Your success is measured in the qualified pipeline, not activity.
What You’ll Own
Pipeline end to end: qualified leads across inbound and outbound channels, from first touch to sales handoff
Paid advertising: Google Ads and LinkedIn, with full budget accountability and a bias toward what actually converts
Organic search and SEO: making Meeting Tomorrow’s content and website attractive to Google and ranking for the terms that matter to our buyers
LLM and GEO: growing Meeting Tomorrow’s presence in AI-powered search and recommendation environments
Agentic workflows: building and managing the automations that drive campaign efficiency and compress time-to-pipeline
Demand gen KPIs: CPL, MQL volume and quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline contribution, and CAC, with regular visibility to leadership
Budget decisions: full accountability for how demand gen dollars are allocated, with the VP of Marketing in the loop
Key Responsibilities
Build and execute the demand generation roadmap, aligned to revenue targets and Sales priorities
Own SEO strategy and execution: keyword targeting, on-page optimization, content signals, and technical SEO in partnership with the web team
Manage paid media across Google and LinkedIn: campaign structure, targeting, creative testing, and budget allocation
Develop Meeting Tomorrow’s presence in AI-powered search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) through GEO strategies
Build and iterate on agentic workflows that automate repeatable marketing functions, from lead scoring to outreach sequencing
Run A/B tests and side-by-side comparisons across channels to continuously improve performance
Partner with Sales on lead handoff, pipeline review cadences, and feedback loops
Ensure all outbound programs comply with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Who You Are
You’re a builder. You see a gap, you close it. You don’t wait for someone to tell you how.
You’re entrepreneurial about channels: when something works, you double down. When it doesn’t, you move on and find what does.
You think in systems and automation. The goal is a demand gen function that compounds over time, not one that depends on you doing everything manually.
You treat Sales like a partner, not an internal customer. Pipeline is a team sport.
You can walk into ambiguity, build structure, and make progress without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook.
 
What You’ve Done
Proven SEO expertise: you know how to make a website and its content rank. You’ve done it, you can show the results, and you understand the technical and content sides of the discipline.

title: Talent Operations Manager
description:

Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms-so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive-designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

You’ll work closely with recruiters, recruiting coordinators, hiring managers, People leaders, and external partners. You’ll make sure our hiring data can answer the questions teams need to make better decisions.

This is a high-leverage role for someone who likes turning messy, fast-moving work into clear operating systems. You’ll help us reduce process drift, improve candidate and interviewer experience, keep hiring data trustworthy, and give the team better visibility into what is working, what is blocked, and where we need to adjust.

title: Staff Product Manager, Growth Alliance (all genders)
description:
The role

HelloFresh's Onboarding squad owns the highest-leverage window in the customer lifecycle: from the moment a prospect converts to the moment they become a settled, loyal customer. Onboarding is the connective tissue that links the conversion funnel to long-term customer value.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead the Onboarding squad and define the product vision for how HelloFresh guides new customers from their first delivery into habitual, high-value subscription. You will own the end-to-end early customer experience across web and app - spanning post-checkout confirmation, subscription management, digital engagement, and the critical Box 1→2→3 progression - across all HelloFresh Group brands, including Factor.

The defining product challenge ahead is building and scaling the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: an ML-powered, segment-aware system that identifies the right action for each customer at each moment in their early lifecycle and delivers it seamlessly across web and app surfaces. This is a genuine 0-to-1 build - one that requires both strategic vision and hands-on execution.

This role demands a PM who is obsessed with solving customer pain points and equally obsessed with the cross-squad collaboration required to do it at scale. Onboarding does not sit inside a single product surface - it spans the activation funnel, CRM and lifecycle communications, app and engagement experiences, and Data Science. The PM leading this squad must be a hyper-collaborator: capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across squads and tribes and bringing coherence to an experience that crosses many surfaces and teams.

What you'll do

• Own the product vision and strategy for the end-to-end Onboarding experience across all HelloFresh Group brands - from post-checkout confirmation to Settled Conversion (3 boxes in 4 weeks).

• Lead the build and scaling of the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: a segment-aware, state-aware personalisation system that dynamically surfaces the right customer action at the right moment across web and app.

• Drive measurable improvement in Settled Conversion rate through a high-velocity experimentation roadmap.

• Own the full-surface onboarding experience - welcome dashboard, subscription management, meal selection flows, app onboarding layer, and CRM-triggered touchpoints - ensuring coherence and quality across every channel and surface.

• Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define the data and ML foundations that power personalised, segment-aware onboarding at scale.

• Act as the connective tissue between squads and tribes: align the Activation funnel squad, CRM and Communications tribe, and App and Engagement team around a unified onboarding strategy and shared north-star metrics.

• Build deep consumer empathy through qualitative research, quantitative funnel analysis, and direct customer engagement - and bring the early customer voice into every product decision.

• Define and own success metrics for Onboarding - Settled Conversion rate, Box 1→2 and 2→3 conversion, app adoption rate, and unwanted box rate - and hold yourself and the squad accountable to them.

• Own BAU operations: triage funnel issues rapidly, maintain onboarding health monitoring, and serve as the escalation point for anything threatening early retention performance.

• Drive cross-functional alignment as a single-threaded leader across global tribes and alliances - creating clarity and shared direction needed for the squad to ship at velocity.

What you'll bring

• Customer Lifecycle & Early Retention Expertise: A deep understanding of subscription customer lifecycle dynamics - churn triggers, early retention levers, and the interplay between product experience and commercial outcomes. You think in journeys, not screens, and you can translate moments of friction or delight into business impact across the Box 0→3 window.

• Cross-Surface Product Leadership: Proven experience owning end-to-end product

This role sits at the intersection of narrative and movement strategy, high-profile coalition leadership, and civics-market building. You will bring together a distinctive set of stakeholders spanning professional sports leagues and franchises, musicians and entertainment partners, philanthropic partners across the ideological spectrum, civics education organizations, and community leaders, around a shared campaign to make founding-principles-based citizenship culturally resonant at national scale. You will integrate the full breadth of Stand Together’s capabilities, from national brand campaigns and content production to fundraising and partner development, to ensure the movement’s narrative, action, and civics pillars compound rather than run independently.
We are looking for someone who operates as the chief executive of a portfolio: reading a fast-moving cultural landscape quickly, prioritizing which opportunities will drive the highest level of impact, making the trade-offs that follow, and building the leaders who will implement the strategies.
The ideal candidate brings experience shaping national-scale brand, cultural, or narrative campaigns, and has a track record of building coalitions with high-profile partners spanning business, entertainment, sports, and philanthropy. Done well, this role will make founding-principles-based citizenship a living part of American culture rather than a civics-class abstraction.

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.   
 
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success.  That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: SW Developer categorie protette L.68/99 (anche art. 18) - Full Remote
description:
Develer è un’azienda del gruppo Comelz, che svolge attività di progettazione, produzione elettronica e sviluppo software per il mondo industriale.
Cerchiamo nuovi collaboratori e collaboratrici da inserire nei nostri team di sviluppo software, appartenenti alle categorie protette, in tre aree:

• Embedded Linux e firmware

• Sviluppo desktop e embedded

• Sviluppo web full stack

Su cosa lavoriamo?
I progetti tipici su cui lavoriamo riguardano:
Embedded Linux e firmware

• Applicazioni ferroviarie, anche in sicurezza

• Controllo di processi di automazione industriale.

• Macchine a controllo numerico, per controllo motori e bus di campo industriali.

• Internet of Things (con trasmissioni dati in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GSM).

• Interfacce utente per dispositivi embedded con display touch.

Sviluppo desktop e embedded

• Controllo di macchine industriali.

• Realizzazione di interfacce utente per dispositivi embedded con display touch.

• Software per il disegno tecnico 2D e 3D per il settore calzaturiero.

Sviluppo web full stack

• Analisi e reportistica di dati acquisiti da macchine industriali.

• Raccolta e visualizzazione di metriche collezionate da applicazioni web.

• Portali per la configurazione e gestione remota di macchine industriali.

A seconda del tipo di progetto, la parte principale del lavoro consisterà in:
Embedded Linux e firmware

• Sviluppare a basso livello su un sistema Linux embedded: realizzazione di BSP, kernel driver, demoni user space.

• Sviluppare in C su bare metal / microcontrollori: driver e uso di RTOS.

• Aiutare il team di progettisti elettronici nel test e debug delle schede progettate.

Sviluppo desktop e embedded

• Realizzare applicazioni multipiattaforma (desktop e tablet), utilizzando le librerie Qt

• Creare interfacce utente, su sistemi desktop o embedded, e costruire il collegamento verso la logica di backend

• Scrivere algoritmi e logiche di backend al servizio delle applicazioni

Sviluppo web full stack

• Realizzare interfacce di controllo per dispositivi industriali accessibili da browser.

• Sviluppare API HTTP per l'interoperabilità di applicazioni web e mobile.

• Creare applicazioni web per per il monitoraggio di dispositivi e la reportistica di dati in tempo reale.

From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end-to-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done.

(Onsite in Boston)

- The DNA to thrive in a start-up, fast-paced environment. Views unstructured environments as an opportunity to figure out the most impactful work and help define the future success of the company

- Strong computer science fundamentals, ideally with a degree in computer science or related field

description:

Ao construir um padrão de comportamento anônimo, único para cada usuário, fornecemos contexto de localização e criamos uma identidade digital privada para a segurança das contas. Empresas com aplicativos e dispositivos conectados usam nossa tecnologia para verificação de identidade de usuários sem fricção, autenticação dinâmica adaptativa, avaliação de risco e detecção de fraude, tudo isso enquanto protegem a privacidade do usuário.

Idealmente, você criou um programa de gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades, um programa de risco de terceiros ou uma estratégia para endpoint, segurança de rede ou de proteção de dados

title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager
description:
Who are we?

Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin ! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.

And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.

If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.

The Team

You will be joining the Detection team, a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error-free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible.

Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs; every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why.

The Detection team is core to Ravelin ’s success. They work in a deeply collaborative partnership with the Data Engineering team to design the data architecture and infrastructure that powers our ML systems.
The Role

We are currently looking for an Engineering Manager to line manage ML engineers and drive innovation across our suite of fraud detection products. You’ll work closely with data scientists, product, engineering and our operations teams to develop ML models and ML products. Our ideal candidate is pragmatic, approachable and filled with knowledge tempered by past failures. You will hire, coach and develop a talented machine learning team to deliver on the ML product and platform roadmap. You are in your element working with people. You’ll partner closely with senior members of Detection to discover new avenues for ML product innovation. From time to time, you’re excited to even do some software or model development yourself.

The work is not all green field research. The everyday work is about making safe incremental progress towards better models for our clients. The ideal candidate is willing to get involved in both aspects of the job - and understand why both are important.
Key Responsibilities

• Act as a key leader in establishing excellence within machine learning engineering and across the detection team

• Line manage a team of machine learning engineers - providing coaching and guidance in support of the ongoing development and growth of your team

• Propose and champion new machine learning methods and tools (including platforms that empower Data Science experimentation) to influence the technical roadmap and promote continuous innovation

• Drive cross-functional initiatives with Data Engineering, Infra, and other teams to align on data architecture and ensure we make the right ML product decisions

• Investigate model performance issues

• Develop and deploy new models to detect fraud whilst maintaining SLAs

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Minimum of 1 year of experience as an engineering manager, managing at least 3 people

• You are a strong collaborator with colleagues outside of your immediate team, for example with data science, engineering, product, client operations teams and with senior leadership

• You know how to manage and retain talented engineers from a diverse range of backgrounds and personalities. You can handle difficult management situations

title: Staff Data Scientist - Geospatial
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

Relay operates a delivery network that generates rich location and movement data every day. Understanding that data - and turning it into improvements across the delivery operation - is the focus of this role.

As Staff Data Scientist for Geospatial, you will own the location and movement datasets that underpin Relay's delivery operation, defining how they are built, measured, and evolved. You will use signals from across the network to build models that make the operation faster and more reliable.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Operational Research and Data Scientists to integrate your data solutions across the Relay network.

What You'll Do

- Define how we measure the quality of our geospatial data: identifying gaps, quantifying their impact on the operation, and prioritising improvements.

- Continuously evolve our location datasets.

- Own the technical strategy and roadmap for Relay's geospatial data solutions.

- Partner with engineering to productionise and integrate solutions into the delivery operation.

- Build observability into pipelines so that degradation in data quality is detected, understood, and acted upon.

- Build reusable data products and define core metrics that add value across the business.

- Coach and mentor other data scientists on technical approach, production standards, and problem decomposition.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

- You have deep experience with geospatial data, telemetry, or GPS trace processing.

- You love maps and urban geography.

- You are motivated by complex problems with high impact.

- You understand what it takes to own a production data product end to end - you treat observability, testing, and incident response as core responsibilities.

- You care about the people your work affects - couriers, retailers, and internal teams all feel the impact of the data products you own.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

- Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

- Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

- 25 days of holidays

- Enhanced parental leave.

- Hardware of your choice.

- Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

- Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experie

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

YOU WILL

- Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles.

- Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline.

- Act as a strategic advisor: Understand enterprise procurement challenges and position Zip as a transformational solution for efficiency and cost control.

- Solution-sell with vision: Demonstrate Zip’s immediate impact while aligning with customers’ long-term digital transformation goals.

- Shape the future: As an early sales leader in a hyper-growth startup, help refine Zip’s sales strategy, process, and team culture.

- Leverage best-in-class sales tools: Utilize Salesforce, Clari, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach to optimize outreach and pipeline management.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals.

- Experience selling to procurement, finance, legal, IT, operations, supply chain, or manufacturing teams.

- Proven success acquiring net-new logos in organizations with 10,000+ employees.

- Skilled in complex sales cycles: Managing multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and driving consensus at the executive level.

- Self-motivated and proactive: You take ownership of your success and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

- Exceptional communication and organization skills to manage multiple opportunities effectively.

The salary range for this role is $300,000 - $350,000 OTE. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

- 📈  Start-up equity

- 🦷  Full health, vision & dental coverage

- 🌴  Flexible PTO

- 💻  Apple equipment plus home office budget

- 💸  401k plan
